subject: Invoice Speedlane enrollment — PO acknowledgement timing and invoice cutoff
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit@skyflowanalytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@skyflowanalytics.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Enrolling Skyflow in 'Invoice Speedlane' (request)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our finance team is keen to enroll Skyflow in Redwood's Invoice Speedlane pilot so we can get faster settlement on accepted invoices — ideally a mix of Net30 for routine services and an accelerated settlement lane for urgent invoices.

Before we push this downstream, can you confirm what your procurement team needs from us to: (1) enable early settlement enrollment, (2) confirm PO acknowledgement timing (so our AP matches cutoffs), and (3) what the invoice cutoff window looks like for weekly payouts?

I'll attach the vendor packet on my next note. For context, our typical PO cadence is: PO issued within 48 hours of SOW acceptance; invoices submitted via vendor portal daily. We prefer a Net30 baseline but are evaluating Net45 for larger milestone invoices.

Appreciate your help — cc'd our billing alias for records.

— Amit
Billing Lead, Skyflow Analytics

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@skyflowanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enrolling Skyflow in 'Invoice Speedlane' (request)

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to get Skyflow set up. Quick overview of what Procurement & AP need to move forward: 

- Completed vendor W-9 (or local tax equivalent) and supplier banking form (for ACH).
- PO intake expectations: Redwood requires an acknowledged PO on our portal within 5 business days of issuance to hit the weekly invoice cutoff. PO acks outside that window shift the invoice to the next week's run.
- Baseline term: we provision Net30 as standard. Net45 can be accommodated for milestone billing but needs procurement approval and updated payment workflow.
- Early settlement (Speedlane): enrollment requires acceptance of the Speedlane terms (short addendum) and confirmation of invoice delivery method (portal vs. emailed invoice). Pricing for the service is applied as a small fee (% of invoice) or a fixed discount from gross depending on the volume profile — our Finance Ops will share the calculation.

Cc'ing Ben and Karthik to confirm PO ack behavior and to see if we can offer a switching window for Skyflow (Net30 baseline + optional accelerated lane for urgent invoices).

Next steps: please send the W-9 and banking form and let me know whether you prefer the portal or SFTP invoice delivery. Once we have that, Ben/Karthik will confirm the earliest possible settlement cutoff and whether Net45 for milestone invoices is approvable.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enrolling Skyflow in 'Invoice Speedlane' (request)

Quick procurement note from our side: 

- PO ack timing: The 5-business-day acknowledgement Grace mentioned is the operational cutoff we use to populate the weekly batch. If Skyflow can acknowledge within 48 hours, we can lock invoices into the same-week run (cutoff is Tuesday 11:59pm PT for payouts on Friday).
- Net45 for milestones: Procurement will require the SOW to reference the Net45 milestone explicitly. We can accommodate this but will ask Finance to tag those invoices so the default AP workflow (Net30) doesn't capture them incorrectly.
- Early settlement: to avoid manual routing delays, we'd like Skyflow to opt into the Speedlane addendum and select portal delivery. That lets our automated engine apply the settlement fee and schedule.

Action for procurement: Karthik, can you confirm whether an exception for mixed-term billing (Net30 baseline + Net45 milestone) needs a PO-level flag or a supplemental contract?

—Ben
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@skyflowanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enrolling Skyflow in 'Invoice Speedlane' (request)

Hi all — short answer: PO-level flag preferred. Details: 

- We can tag POs with a payment-term attribute (payment_terms: NET30 or NET45-MILESTONE) in our vendor portal. That tag flows to AP and to the Speedlane automation. 
- If Skyflow wants milestone invoices to carry Net45, ask your contracts team to include a note in the SOW and include the milestone invoice IDs on the PO. Procurement will then enable a PO flag and Finance will honour Net45 for those invoice IDs only.
- Cutoff / speedlane enrollment: recommend portal delivery + a single contact for exception approvals. If you want guaranteed Friday settlement for urgent invoices, submit invoices by Tuesday 11:59pm PT and mark them "SPEEDLANE-URGENT" in the portal. We will then route those to the accelerated queue (subject to the Speedlane fee).

I'll attach a short checklist and the portal field names (see link below). Once we have the W-9 + banking form and a signed Speedlane addendum, we can flip the enrollment switch.

Thanks — Karthik
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference

----- Forwarded link: Speedlane field mapping -----
Portal Field: vendor_payment_terms
Portal Field: speedlane_opt_in (boolean)
Portal Field: speedlane_priority (enum: normal, urgent)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@skyflowanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Enrolling Skyflow in 'Invoice Speedlane' (request)

Amit — thanks, this is great. Attached are the W-9 and banking form you can complete and return. A couple small clarifications before we proceed: 

- Please confirm portal delivery (vs. SFTP). Portal is strongly preferred for Speedlane.
- If you want Net45 only on milestone invoices, include the milestone code on the PO when it is issued and have your contracts team add the Net45 note in the SOW.
- If you want to trial weekly expedited settlement for a specific vendor/BU, we can put Skyflow on a 6-week pilot and track unit economics. I'll ask Finance Ops to send a sample settlement calculation once you confirm volume ranges.

Next steps for Skyflow (action items):
1) Complete and return Skyflow_Supplier_W9.pdf and Skyflow_Bank_Info_Form.pdf (attached).
2) Confirm portal invoice delivery and the contact person for exception approvals.
3) Sign the Speedlane addendum (I'll share the DocuSign link after step 2).

Ben/Karthik — once Amit returns the forms, please approve the PO flag workflow and confirm the earliest enrollment date.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
attachments: Skyflow_Supplier_W9.pdf (application/pdf), Skyflow_Bank_Info_Form.pdf (application/pdf)
